name: Venkys (India) Ltd
title: Venkys (India) Ltd - 523261 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 margin spike driven by broiler realisation; April broiler prices ~INR97-100 falling to ~INR90-93 by May, chick prices fell from ~INR55 to ~INR35, so Q1 trend is softer despite oil-seed utilisation rising to a targeted 80%.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization today is around 65% to 70%. And this year, we expect to be around 80%.

triggers.label: Oil processing utilisation 65-70% → ~80%
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization today is around 65% to 70%. And this year, we expect to be around 80%.

triggers.label: Broiler prices falling from Q4 peak
triggers.quote: But now from 10th May, 11th May onwards, it is a little bit on the falling side.

triggers.label: Broiler chick price INR55 → INR35
triggers.quote: It went up to even INR55 per kg per bird, number bird, day-old broiler chicks, which has come down to the level of INR35.

triggers.label: Layer chicks 4.57 cr → 5 cr+ FY27
triggers.quote: We are planning to sell almost 5 crores plus chicks during this '26-'27.

guidance.quote: We are planning to sell almost 5 crores plus chicks during this '26-'27.
the Animal Health business will definitely grow in the double digit.

guidance.value: 22-23% and above for the whole year
guidance.quote: for whole year, I think it will sustain 22%, 23% and above
And this year, we expect to be around 80%.

red_flags.label: CCI antitrust probe on parent breeding farms
red_flags.quote: this CCI investigation is regarding certain practices in the parent companies or the parent breeding farms

red_flags.label: Broiler volume down YoY
red_flags.quote: The volume of commercial broiler birds is 8.69 crores in '25-'26 against the previous year, it was 9.17 crores birds.
